about: Hand-written expectations for #50 (tools/qualify_first_use_areas.py). Over the packaged synthetic example S0 (tests/fixtures/incidents/S0.csv): 14 incidents, all opened at 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC; INC01-07 and INC13 have a Resolved record three hours later; INC08-12 and INC14 have none. An expectation from Opened to Resolved with a 2-hour target and 2 hours partly met after it, a missing response counted as not met: three hours is half way into the width, 0.5; no response is 1. The step keeps the incidents where Assigned directly follows Opened. Never read by product code.
